title: Delocalizing a smooth factorization over a localized base
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $A$ an $R$-algebra of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra] ($A\cong R[x_1,\dots,x_n]/(g_1,\dots,g_t)$), $\Lambda$ an $R$-algebra and $\alpha:A\to\Lambda$ a homomorphism of $R$-algebras. Let $S\subset R$ be a multiplicative subset, write $S^{-1}R$, $S^{-1}A$, $S^{-1}\Lambda$ for the localizations at $S$ (resp. at its images) [def-weil-pbc-module-localization] and $S^{-1}\alpha:S^{-1}A\to S^{-1}\Lambda$, $a/u\mapsto\alpha(a)/u$, and let $S^{-1}A\xrightarrow{\beta'}B'\xrightarrow{\gamma'}S^{-1}\Lambda$ be homomorphisms of $S^{-1}R$-algebras with $\gamma'\circ\beta'=S^{-1}\alpha$ and $B'$ a smooth $S^{-1}R$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map]. Then there are an $R$-algebra $B$ of finite presentation, homomorphisms of $R$-algebras $A\xrightarrow{\beta}B\xrightarrow{\gamma}\Lambda$ with $\gamma\circ\beta=\alpha$, and an element $s\in S$ whose image in $B$ is elementary standard in $B$ over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-strictly-standard-element].

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, Lemma Tag 07F4 (lemma-delocalize-base, line 1937) and its proof (lines 1946-1997; the ring B constructed there is R[x_1,...,x_{n+m}]/(s'_1f_1,...,s'_cf_c,g_1,...,g_t), of finite presentation); uses Lemma lemma-smooth-standard-smooth and Lemma lemma-standard-smooth-include-generators

proof.text: Apply the smooth-retract lemma to B′, obtaining a standard smooth D and maps iota,rho with rho iota=id. Reroute the two maps through D; associativity of algebra-homomorphism composition and the retraction identity prove that their composite remains the localized alpha.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, Lemma Tag 07F4 (lemma-delocalize-base), proof

proof.text: Choose a finite presentation P of A using Presentation.exists_presentation_fin. Apply the prescribed-generator standard-smooth-presentation lemma to D and the images of its generators under the rerouted map, obtaining Q with an initial Jacobian and the required first-variable values.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, Lemma Tag 07F4 (lemma-delocalize-base), proof

proof.text: Apply the polynomial-certificate theorem to P,Q and the rerouted factorization to obtain F,l,s,a_0, the evaluation identities, the Jacobian congruence and the remaining-relation ideal conditions.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, Lemma Tag 07F4 (lemma-delocalize-base), proof

proof.text: Construct B explicitly as ULift of T/(F), with quotient map q. Its generators are q(X_i); the kernel equality gives a finite presentation PB. Rename the original relations; each is among the F, so q kills them. AlgHom.liftOfSurjective descends q composed with renaming to beta:A->B. Evaluation at l kills (F), so Ideal.Quotient.lift_a gives gamma:B->Lambda. The composite agrees with alpha on the generators of P, and cancellation along its surjective evaluation proves gamma beta=alpha.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, Lemma Tag 07F4 (lemma-delocalize-base), proof

proof.text: Evaluate the Jacobian congruence along PB to obtain algebraMap(s)=aeval(a_0) times the initial Jacobian determinant. The lift PB.sigma(algebraMap(s)) differs from C(s) by an element of (F), so multiplying this difference by any remaining relation belongs to (F)^2. Add it to the certificate membership C(s)F_j in the initial ideal. These are precisely the two defining conditions of IsElementaryStandardElement.

split_report.summary: Proof written in 11 steps following the Stacks proof of 07F4 line by line: reduction to B' standard smooth via 07CH (which gives a standard smooth B'' with a retraction onto B', not a localization: the factorization is rerouted through B'' and the retraction); presentation of A and the lambda_i; standard smooth presentation of B' containing the images of the generators of A (07EY); the rescaling of the extra variables by elements of S, written out with the Jacobian (Stacks one sentence); the localization facts for R[x] -> S^{-1}R[x] (polynomial-scalar-extension + localization-base-change leaves); clearing denominators of f_j and a_j (relation s_0 = a_0 Delta + sum a_j f_j); s_j for the g_j, s'_j for the f_j(lambda); B, beta, gamma; the verification of both conditions of 'elementary standard' (Definition 07C7 (1), as in the statement; not 'strictly standard') with a' = s_1...s_t a_0. Statement: unchanged in content; S^{-1}A, S^{-1}Lambda, S^{-1}alpha spelled out and stmt_deps gained def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra and def-weil-pbc-module-localization. New nodes: lem-weil-pbc-smooth-retract-standard-smooth (07CH), lem-weil-pbc-standard-smooth-include-generators (07EY, stated for a family a_1..a_n as the proof allows). Stacks typo '(f_1, ..., x_c)' at line 1973 read as (f_1,...,f_c).
